name: fxlint sample: intentional failures
description: fxlint fixture (tests/fxlint/): every def in data/effects/defs/ here is DELIBERATELY broken, one distinct mistake per file, so fxlint's error catalog (FXD_*) can be demonstrated and regression-tested end to end. Modeled on the MODDABILITY-REVIEW-1 'best artifact in the tree' pattern -- an intentional-failure mod proves the linter's file:line:key feedback is real, not aspirational. Do not fix these files; they are supposed to fail.
